Detailed Description

A BinaryOpUGen usually created using the function sqrsum() when applied to other UGen instances.

It is not normally required to use this UGen explicitly. 

 UGen resultSqrSum  = SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4).sqrsum(SinOsc::AR(400, 0, 0.3)); // creates a BinarySqrSumUGen
You can also use a global version of this function, the above code would be equivalent as: 
 UGen resultSqrSum  =  sqrsum(SinOsc::AR(100, 0, 0.4), SinOsc::AR(400, 0, 0.3)); // creates a BinarySqrSumUGen
See also:
